description: Foundation layer for Issue #18 favorites: a PURE, guarded localStorage-backed favorites store, a React FavoritesContext/provider mirroring the ThemeContext pattern, PURE bracket helpers that derive a favorite's path/status/elimination, and all new EN/JA i18n strings. No UI wiring into existing components yet (that is FEAT-002), but the provider is mounted in main.tsx. This feature is fully unit/component tested and leaves the app building and green.
steps: Create frontend/src/favorites.ts as a PURE, framework-free module mirroring frontend/src/theme.ts. Export: const FAVORITES_STORAGE_KEY = 'mlb.favorites'; readStoredFavorites(): number[] (guarded try/catch; if localStorage is undefined or JSON.parse throws, return []; parse the stored JSON and KEEP ONLY finite integer team ids, dropping NaN/strings/dupes/corrupt entries - de-duplicate preserving first-seen order); storeFavorites(ids: number[]): void (guarded; JSON.stringify, swallow write errors); and PURE array helpers addFavorite(ids, id), removeFavorite(ids, id), toggleFavorite(ids, id), isFavorite(ids, id) that return new arrays (immutable; no dupes; toggle adds if absent, removes if present). Multiple favorites allowed. Follow the exact JSDoc/guarding style of theme.ts.

Create frontend/src/favorites.test.ts (vitest) covering: readStoredFavorites returns [] when key is absent; parses a valid array of ids; DROPS corrupt values (non-JSON string, JSON that is not an array, array containing strings/NaN/floats/duplicates) and returns a clean integer array; storeFavorites round-trips through readStoredFavorites; add/remove/toggle/isFavorite behavior incl. idempotent add and toggle both directions; guarding does not throw when localStorage throws (simulate by stubbing). Use the localStorage available under jsdom (frontend/src/test/setup.ts) and clear it between tests.

Create frontend/src/FavoritesContext.tsx mirroring frontend/src/ThemeContext.tsx: a FavoritesProvider that hydrates state from readStoredFavorites() (with an optional initialFavorites prop for tests), exposes { favorites: number[], isFavorite(id), toggle(id), add(id), remove(id) } via a useFavorites() hook, and persists every change with storeFavorites(). useFavorites() throws if used outside the provider (match useTheme's guard). Keep it guarded/inert under jsdom.

Create frontend/src/FavoritesContext.test.tsx: render a tiny probe component inside FavoritesProvider; assert toggle adds then removes an id, add/remove are idempotent, state persists to localStorage under 'mlb.favorites', and a fresh provider rehydrates persisted favorites. Assert useFavorites() throws outside a provider.

Add PURE bracket helpers to frontend/src/bracketLayout.ts (alongside seriesLeaderId/clinchWins, reusing clinchWins and ROUND_ORDER): findTeamSeries(bracket, teamId): Series[] - every series where teamId === series.high.teamId or series.low.teamId, in ROUND_ORDER then existing sort order. isTeamEliminated(bracket, teamId): boolean - true iff the team appears in at least one status==='final' series it LOST (its wins < clinchWins(bestOf)); false if it never lost a final (still active or champion). favoriteSummary(bracket, teamId): a small object describing the team's current standing for the header pin, e.g. { teamId, inBracket: boolean, eliminated: boolean, isChampion: boolean, currentSeries: Series | null (the team's in_progress series, else its next 'scheduled' series, else null), furthestRound: RoundName | null, record?: { wins, losses } for the current/last series }. Keep logic consistent with computeStandings() in StandingsPanel.tsx (champion = won a final World Series). Return a clearly-typed result (export the interface). Document that a team not in the bracket yields inBracket:false and the UI renders nothing for it.

Add frontend/src/bracketLayout.test.ts cases (extend the existing file) for the new helpers using fixture brackets that include BOTH an eliminated team (a team that lost a final series) and an active team (a team in an in_progress series), plus a team NOT in the bracket. Assert findTeamSeries returns the right series in round order, isTeamEliminated is true for the loser of a final and false for an active/champion team, and favoriteSummary reports eliminated/active/champion/currentSeries/inBracket correctly incl. the not-in-bracket case. Reuse/extend frontend/src/test/fixtures.ts (sampleBracket has wildCardSeries where 116 beat 117 => 117 eliminated/116 active, and worldSeries where 119 beat 147 => 119 champion/147 eliminated); add an in_progress series fixture if needed for the active-but-not-final case.

Add ALL new UI strings to frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts: extend the MessageKey union AND add both en and ja values (ja is default). Needed keys (names are suggestions - keep the dotted convention): favorites.add ('Add {team} to favorites' / '{team}をお気に入りに追加'), favorites.remove ('Remove {team} from favorites' / '{team}をお気に入りから外す'), favorites.marker (visually-hidden/aria text identifying a favorite's series, e.g. 'Favorite team's series' / 'お気に入りチームのシリーズ'), favorites.badge ('Favorite' / 'お気に入り'), favorites.eliminated ('Eliminated' / '敗退'), favorites.champion ('Champion' / '優勝'), favorites.header.title (header pin region label, e.g. 'Your teams' / 'あなたのチーム'), favorites.header.status.leading / .trailing / .tied / .inProgress / .scheduled / .nextGame (localized current-series status phrases, reusing {round}/{wins}/{losses}/{time} params as needed - e.g. EN 'Division Series, leading {wins}-{losses}', JA '地区シリーズ、{wins}-{losses}でリード'), favorites.filter.label ('Show only my teams' / 'お気に入りのチームだけ表示'), favorites.filter.empty (empty-state when the filter is on but no favorite has a series in this bracket, e.g. 'None of your favorite teams have a series in this bracket.' / 'お気に入りのチームのシリーズはこのトーナメント表にありません。'). Keep EN/JA wording natural; do not use em dashes.

Add a messages i18n test assertion (extend frontend/src/i18n/index.test.ts): every new MessageKey exists in BOTH en and ja dictionaries (there is likely already a parity test over MESSAGES - make sure the new keys are covered; if the parity test iterates keys automatically, no change beyond adding keys is needed).

Mount the provider: in frontend/src/main.tsx wrap <App/> with <FavoritesProvider> alongside the existing ThemeProvider/I18nProvider (order does not matter functionally; place it inside I18nProvider so favorites UI can translate). Do NOT change App.tsx behavior otherwise.
Run the frontend unit suite and the full build to confirm green before handing off to FEAT-002.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/favorites.ts exists with FAVORITES_STORAGE_KEY='mlb.favorites', guarded readStoredFavorites/storeFavorites, and pure add/remove/toggle/isFavorite; corrupt stored values are ignored and never throw.
frontend/src/FavoritesContext.tsx exposes useFavorites() with favorites/isFavorite/toggle/add/remove, persists to localStorage, and throws when used outside the provider.
frontend/src/bracketLayout.ts exports findTeamSeries, isTeamEliminated, favoriteSummary with an exported result type, consistent with computeStandings elimination/champion logic.
All new favorites strings exist in BOTH en and ja in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts and the MessageKey union, including an 'Eliminated'/'敗退' string.
New unit tests for favorites.ts, FavoritesContext.tsx, and the three bracket helpers (covering an eliminated team, an active team, and a not-in-bracket team) all pass.
verification: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test -w frontend (all vitest suites pass, including the new favorites.test.ts, FavoritesContext.test.tsx, and bracketLayout.test.ts cases)
findings: Implemented the FEAT-001 foundation layer. New frontend/src/favorites.ts is a pure guarded localStorage model (key 'mlb.favorites', JSON int array) mirroring theme.ts: readStoredFavorites (drops non-array/non-JSON/strings/NaN/floats/dupes, de-duped first-seen, never throws), storeFavorites, and immutable add/remove/toggle/isFavorite. frontend/src/FavoritesContext.tsx mirrors ThemeContext with FavoritesProvider (initialFavorites prop + localStorage hydration), useFavorites() exposing {favorites,isFavorite,toggle,add,remove} and throwing outside a provider; persists every change. Added pure helpers findTeamSeries (ROUND_ORDER then bracket order), isTeamEliminated (lost a final series), and favoriteSummary (exported FavoriteSummary interface: inBracket/eliminated/isChampion/currentSeries/furthestRound/record) to bracketLayout.ts, consistent with StandingsPanel computeStandings. Added an inProgressSeries fixture (Mets 121 vs Brewers 158, in_progress) for the active-not-final case. Added all EN/JA favorites.* i18n strings (incl. favorites.eliminated 'Eliminated'/'敗退') to messages.ts MessageKey union + both dictionaries, plus a dictionary-parity test in i18n/index.test.ts. Mounted FavoritesProvider in main.tsx inside I18nProvider; App.tsx unchanged. No star/highlight/pin/filter UI wiring (that is FEAT-002). Verification: `npm test -w frontend` => 21 files / 152 tests pass (incl. new favorites.test.ts, FavoritesContext.test.tsx, bracketLayout new cases, i18n parity); `npm run build` (shared->backend->frontend->infra) passes. Fixed one TS6133 unused-import (afterEach) during build. Commit 3fb511a on feat/mlb-postseason-site. Note: the console error 'useFavorites must be used within a FavoritesProvider' seen in the test log is the expected output of the passing throw-outside-provider test, not a failure.
